commits.headline: feat(tools): the two boot functions whose level copies only a measured pairing tells apart
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
config/levels/boot_pairs.tsv keeps the pairing the old level catalogue
measured for the two boot functions whose identical copies the catalogue
cannot assign by order (50 places); everywhere else the catalogue already
agrees with it. With the C regenerated: 16,716 level placements, 41 of the
old ones still assembly.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.headline: chore: remove the campaign, proof and generated-source system
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
What the new build replaces goes: the generated units (candidates/), the
fragments and their recipes (src/**/*.cfrag, config/source-layout.json),
the per-level catalogues and evidence (config/function-catalog/,
config/function-evidence/, config/level-native/, config/level-g8/, ...),
every proof and report under progress/, the 75 scripts and 78 tests of
the campaign tooling, the Qwen trials, tools/ee/ and tools/linux/, the old
workflows and the reservation template, and the ~75 documents about…

commits.headline: docs: README, building, levels and contributing for the new layout
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
README with the progress table tools/progress.py writes (each distinct
function once), docs/BUILDING.md (discs, compilers, containers on macOS),
docs/LEVELS.md (the level archive, the catalogue, how the level C is laid
out and linked), docs/REGIONS.md with the three releases' disc hashes, and
new CONTRIBUTING.md, AGENTS.md, LEGAL.md, PR and issue templates. Links into
removed documents keep their text. CI (.github/workflows/checks.yml) runs
the tool tests and checks the catalogues and that…

commits.headline: chore: license under GPL-3.0, like rac1-decomp and OpenRAC
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The repository moves from MIT to GPL-3.0 so code can move freely between the
OpenRAC projects. The MIT notices of the code released under MIT so far (the
project up to d46a3539, Lombyte's patches and recipe, the PAL functional
port) are kept in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md, as that licence requires.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.headline: feat(src): rac1-decomp's matched SDK and library C for 208 boot functions
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
216 functions of the boot have the same code as functions rac1-decomp has
matched (its core: libmpeg, libkernl, libc, the IPU and SIF libraries...);
their C comes over into src/boot/sdk/ under rac2's names, each with a line
naming its rac1 source. A name the carried code uses with no rac2 counterpart
yet keeps an r1_ prefix: it states no address, and the build reads its value
from the bytes. include/ now has rac1's headers: include_asm.h (the same
markers, here empty: the build takes a function…
